explainer.draft: This contribution is not yet visible for review.
explainer.under_review: This contribution is being discussed, challenged, and strengthened before a decision.
explainer.vote_scheduled: Voting is scheduled; participants can prepare before ballots open.
explainer.vote_open: This contribution is now open for decision.
explainer.implemented: This contribution is reflected in implementation or follow-up work.

artifact.readinessIntro: Each row ties to this page where it can: Activity and Relationships use the same data the checklist describes.
artifact.readinessHeading: What needs to happen before voting?
artifact.transitionHeading: This contribution may be ready for voting
artifact.transitionBody: It has enough review activity to move toward a decision. Confirm the decision question and open voting when ready.
artifact.relEmpty: No linked artifacts in this category yet.
artifact.relationshipsIntro: Structural links between artifacts (supports / opposes / builds_on). The readiness checklist above references these sections.
artifact.castVoteHint: Review the contribution and linked evidence before voting.
artifact.commentsEmpty: No comments yet. Be the first!
artifact.evidenceEmpty: No evidence yet. Add the first reference!
artifact.evidenceUrlHelp: Link to external evidence, research, or related content

demo.title: Consent-based agent boundaries
demo.body: Proposal body (fixture). In production this is Markdown or rich text from Artifact.body / summary.

readinessDetailTemplate.discussion: {{count}} event(s) logged in Activity – comments, evidence, and supports.
readinessDetailTemplate.supports: {{count}} linked artifact(s) under Supports (artifact relation: supports).
readinessDetailTemplate.opposes: {{count}} linked artifact(s) under Opposition (artifact relation: opposes).
readinessDetailTemplate.scope: Checked against the proposal body above – no separate artifact list.
readinessDetailTemplate.question: Set when opening voting (moderators confirm the exact ballot question).

artifact.devHints: Dev only (debug mode): ?scenario= (under_review, under_review_ready, vote_scheduled, vote_open, approved, implemented, draft). To wire Support/Oppose to the real API, set env SOFT_LAUNCH_WIRED_ARTIFACT_ID to a real artifact UUID and sign in.

votePanel.tallyNote: Per-option tallies require an admin/API summary; raw API uses yes/no/abstain.

js.signInSupport: Sign in to record support or opposition on a real artifact.
js.previewOnly: “{{action}}” – preview only (not saved yet). Wire Support/Oppose by setting SOFT_LAUNCH_WIRED_ARTIFACT_ID and signing in.
js.scheduleNoLayer: Artifact must belong to a layer to schedule a vote
js.scheduleNoSubmission: This artifact has no linked submission; create or link a submission before scheduling an approval vote.
js.scheduleSuccess: Vote scheduled! Update artifact status to vote_scheduled to see it.

prefix.label: Prefix
prefix.taken: That prefix is already in use.
prefix.invalidFormat: Prefix must be exactly 2 uppercase letters.
prefix.cannotDeleteDefault: Cannot delete the default prefix. Set another prefix as default first.
prefix.lastPrefix: A layer must have at least one prefix.
prefix.empty: No layer prefixes available. Ask a layer admin to add one in the layer's Admin tab.
prefix.noAccess: Sign in to choose a draft prefix.
prefix.confirmDeleteBody: Delete this prefix? Drafts already created will keep their existing identifier.
prefix.confirmDeleteDefaultBody: This is the current default prefix. Mark another prefix as default first, then delete this one.
prefix.manageNothing: No layer selected – open a layer page first to manage that layer's prefixes.
